name: Glamour

components.pose: He stands angled about 45 degrees to the camera in a heroic three-quarter pose, weight on the back leg, one shoulder forward, glancing toward the camera with a bold, confident look and a slight smirk, the wind streaming through his hair.
components.wearing: fitted Windswept Jade-toned banded leather armor across the chest and shoulders, Cloud White stitching and buckles, arms left bare for freedom of movement, a reinforced belt and leg wraps; a feathered half-cloak at one shoulder, wind-sigils stitched along the collar
components.effects: A playful breeze lifts his half-cloak, faint {{MAGIC}} light glinting in the wind - understated, nothing busy.

notes: Daily-post glamour shot: signature armor, heroic three-quarter pose, element-matched background, light magic only.
